name: true_rebeat
eq_intent: Shape recreated drums, bass, music, and FX on their own buses before master tone.
compression_intent: Source-specific compression: drums 2:1 to 4:1, bass leveling 2:1 to 3:1, music bus light glue.
de_esser_intent: Vocal-only if vocals exist; never placed on the whole rebeat unless measured as necessary.
ms_eq_intent: Mono low-end, preserve centered groove, widen music only after mono compatibility check.
